# S2 conformance traceability

<!-- Generated by WWCP_S2Tests/Architecture/ConformanceDocumentTests.cs - do not edit by hand:
       S2_UPDATE_CONFORMANCE=1 dotnet test WWCP_S2Tests/WWCP_S2Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ConformanceDocumentTests"
     A test states the rule it exercises with [S2C("<area>.<rule>")]; this file is the index of those statements. -->

Every rule below is a normative statement of the
[S2 Connect 1.0.0 specification](https://docs.s2standard.org/s2-connect/1.0.0/), of its OpenAPI
files, or of the S2 JSON message rules collected in [PLAN.md](PLAN.md) §3.3, and every row names a
test that exercises it. The reference is written into the test itself as `[S2C("Pairing.8A")]`, so
the two cannot drift apart unnoticed: this document is regenerated from those properties and
compared on every test run.

What this shows is which rules the implementation *asserts*, and where to look when one of them is
in question. What it does not show: that the rules are complete (a rule nobody tagged is invisible
here), nor that the implementation interoperates with anyone else's - that is measured against the
reference implementations in
[S2ConformanceTests](https://github.com/OpenChargingCloud/S2ConformanceTests).
